SpaceX footage from inside space looks nothing like the launch
What SpaceX hardware looks like once it reaches space
caption:
SpaceX has been reaching orbit for over a decade. Most of the footage you see covers the launch. Almost none of it shows what the machines look like once they actually get there.

This clip does. At this altitude there is no air, no drag, and almost no sound. These are fully operational machines, moving faster than most people can picture, and they look like something from a film.

One of the more underrated things SpaceX does is document it this well.
